name: shut
description: Two rules that cut what a coding agent writes: comments (CCShut) and talk (BeQuiet).

plugins.name: ccshut
plugins.description: Holds code comments to two gates: a comment ships only if it stays true after the code is rewritten and a senior could not have recovered it from the code. One dated line each, under 5% of a file's lines.

plugins.name: bequiet
plugins.description: Splits session speech into four shapes: a four-word English step label while working, plain Ukrainian for the question, the warning and the 8-line final answer. No progress chatter, no announcing a tool call.
